verdict.rationale: Viam documents logic modules that run on the machine to execute continuous processes and scheduled actions, and to react to sensor data or coordinate components (e.g., a threshold crossing fires a notification or a camera detection drives a motor). Inline modules let Viam manage the build and deployment of that code, which is a first-party way to set up autonomous background automations. Missing for 10: detailed docs on scheduling and trigger configuration, a no-code or declarative automation builder (automations require writing module code), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
